environment.database: local Docker PostgreSQL (scripts/test-db-local.cjs container, database bodhinox_perf)
environment.postgres: PostgreSQL 18.6 (Debian 18.6-1.pgdg12+2) on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 12.2.0-14+deb12u1) 12.2.0, 64-bit
environment.sameMachine: database and measuring process on one laptop; production (Railway) network latency is not included

results.label: Inbox load (all conversations, contact + tags embed)

explain.statement: SELECT c.*, to_jsonb(ct) AS contact FROM conversations c LEFT JOIN contacts ct ON ct.id = c.contact_id WHERE c.account_id = $1 ORDER BY c.last_message_at DESC NULLS LAST, c.id LIMIT 1000 OFFSET 4000

results.label: Contact search (3 characters)
results.how: contacts page query (or name/phone/email ilike, exact count, 25 rows) through executeQuery(browser=true)

explain.statement: SELECT * FROM contacts WHERE account_id = $1 AND (name ILIKE '%kum%' OR phone ILIKE '%kum%' OR email ILIKE '%kum%') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 25

results.label: CRM route: contacts list page
results.how: the /api/crm/[resource] query (contacts, exact count, 25 rows) through executeQuery(browser=true); handler session and HTTP not included

explain.statement: SELECT * FROM contacts WHERE account_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 25

results.label: Booking route: one week of the schedule
results.how: listSchedule inside withTenant as bodhinox_app (the GET /api/appointments query); handler session and HTTP not included

explain.statement: SELECT a.* FROM appointments a WHERE a.account_id = $1 AND a.start_at < $3 AND a.end_at > $2 ORDER BY a.start_at, a.id LIMIT 500

results.label: Analytics 30-day overview
results.how: runAnalytics (statement timeout, workspace timezone) + conversationStats for the range and the previous one, as bodhinox_app

results.label: Inbound text webhook to visible in the inbox query
results.how: persistWebhook + the whatsapp.webhook job handler (worker role) + a messages read through executeQuery(browser=true); in process, no HTTP
results.note: Target 5 s with 1 s worker polling: the measured time must stay within 4 s so that with the polling wait it is within 5 s.
